billing-incident-sop.content:
---
name: billing-incident-sop
description: "Billing Incident SOP for identifying shared billing-cluster incidents and escalating covered tickets without closing them."
---
## 适用条件
Use for open tickets describing a billing or payment cluster failure when at least two open tickets share that same cluster or confirmed root cause.
## 排除条件
Do not classify unrelated clusters, such as promo-cluster, or routine reporting and other non-incident requests as billing incidents; do not close tickets.
## 操作步骤
1. Inspect all open tickets and their detailed descriptions.
2. Group tickets by billing or payment cluster and confirmed shared root cause.
3. Escalate a group when two or more open tickets share the same billing cluster or root cause.
4. Set each covered ticket priority to high and category to incident.
5. Add the incident-core tag and an internal note explaining the shared-cluster basis.
6. Leave every covered ticket open for the on-call billing engineer.
## 验证
- Confirm at least two open tickets support the same billing cluster or root cause.
- Confirm every covered ticket has priority high, category incident, and tag incident-core.
- Confirm covered tickets remain open and unrelated or routine tickets are unchanged.

args.content:
---
name: billing-incident-sop
description: "Current Billing Incident SOP v2 for identifying shared billing-cluster incidents and escalating covered tickets without closing them."
---
## Scope
Use for open tickets describing a shared billing or payment cluster failure.

## Escalation Trigger
Escalate when at least 3 tickets from distinct reporters identify the same billing cluster failure within a 4-hour window. Groups of only 2 tickets, or single-reporter tickets without additional confirmation, do not qualify.

## Exclusions
Do not classify UI bugs, slow performance on non-cluster services, document requests, access requests, routine report requests, or tickets with separate root causes as billing incidents. Do not close tickets.

## Required Actions
1. Inspect all open billing tickets and their detailed descriptions; identify the cluster name, distinct reporters, root cause, and time window.
2. For every ticket in a qualifying cluster group, set priority to critical.
3. Set category to incident-billing.
4. Add both tags: incident-core and billing-sla-breach.
5. Add an internal note explaining the shared-cluster basis.
6. Leave every covered ticket open for the on-call billing engineer.
7. Output one line per updated ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

## Verification
- Confirm at least 3 distinct reporters point to the same cluster within 4 hours.
- Confirm every covered ticket has priority critical, category incident-billing, and both required tags.
- Confirm covered tickets remain open and excluded or unrelated tickets are unchanged.

billing-refund-sop.content:
---
name: billing-refund-sop
description: "Distinguish routine refund requests from refund-related billing cluster failures."
---
## 适用条件
Use when deciding whether a refund-related ticket is a routine request or a possible shared billing-cluster incident.
## 排除条件
Does not define refund approval or payment execution procedures. A refund-related title alone does not establish or exclude a cluster incident.
## 操作步骤
1. Read the ticket's detailed description to distinguish a routine refund request or reconciliation report from a service failure affecting refund processing.
2. Treat routine refund requests as non-incidents. Under an incident-only triage task, leave routine requests unchanged.
3. For refund processing failures linked to a shared billing cluster, apply billing-incident-sop to establish the reporter and time-window threshold and perform any required escalation.
## 验证
- Confirm classification follows the reported failure or request, rather than the presence of the word refund.
- Confirm any refund-related cluster escalation satisfies the current billing-incident-sop; routine refund requests remain excluded from incident classification.
组合依赖 ["billing-incident-sop"]

billing-cluster-incident-triage.content:
---
name: billing-cluster-incident-triage
description: "Correlate open billing tickets by shared cluster failure, apply the current SOP's reporter and timing thresholds, and update only qualifying incident tickets while preserving their open status."
---
## 适用条件
Use when asked to triage open helpdesk tickets under a billing incident SOP that specifies cluster correlation, escalation thresholds, required ticket fields, and exclusions.
## 排除条件
Do not apply incident mutations to below-threshold groups, unrelated clusters, UI bugs, non-cluster performance issues, document or access requests, or routine reports when excluded by the current SOP. Resolution and closure belong to the on-call engineer.
## 操作步骤
1. Read the current task's SOP for thresholds, time window, required fields, exclusions, and output format. Search the KB and retrieve the relevant full article when required; use a brief reference as supporting context rather than a replacement for explicit SOP rules.
2. List all open tickets and read their full descriptions, reporters, timestamps, tags, and status before selecting any tickets for mutation.
3. Group tickets by the same named cluster and supported common failure. Include downstream symptoms such as worker crashes when the description explicitly links them to that cluster outage; keep different clusters separate.
4. For each group, count tickets from distinct reporters within the SOP's time window. Under Billing Incident SOP v2, require at least three within four hours; two affected teams or a narrative claim do not establish three qualifying tickets.
5. Apply the SOP exclusions by the substance of each request. A routine SLA report remains a report request even if its title or description mentions billing incidents or breaches.
6. Update every ticket in a qualifying incident group with the SOP's exact priority, category, and tags. Under v2, use critical, incident-billing, incident-core, and billing-sla-breach. Preserve unrelated fields and existing tags; leave excluded and nonqualifying tickets unchanged.
7. Inspect update results to confirm the requested fields and that ticket status remains open. Do not close tickets; leave resolution to the on-call billing engineer.
8. Return one line per successfully updated ticket in the requested format. Under v2, use TICKET_ID|priority|category|why, with a brief reason grounded in the shared failure and threshold evidence.
## 验证
- Every inspected ticket is accounted for as qualifying, below threshold, or excluded before mutation; tickets from different clusters are not combined to reach a threshold.
- Each escalated group has the required number of distinct reporters and supporting timestamps within the current SOP's window.
- Mutation results confirm the required priority, category, and tags on every qualifying ticket, with open status preserved and unrelated tickets left unchanged.
- Final output contains exactly the successfully updated tickets, with field values matching confirmed results and reasons supported by the ticket evidence.

billing-incident-triage.content:
---
name: billing-incident-triage
description: "Triage open billing tickets under a supplied incident SOP using cluster, reporter, and time evidence; verify scoped updates."
---
## 适用条件
Use when asked to apply a billing incident SOP across open helpdesk tickets, with a reporter threshold and reporting window.
## 排除条件
Does not authorize incident resolution, ticket closure, or updates to unrelated, excluded, or below-threshold tickets.
## 操作步骤
1. Read the supplied SOP for its escalation threshold, time window, required fields, exclusions, and output format.
2. List all open tickets and read their full details before classifying. Record cluster, reporter identity, ticket time, symptoms, and existing state.
3. Group tickets by the same billing cluster failure. Include downstream symptoms when the details explicitly establish the same root cause; keep different clusters separate.
4. Apply the SOP threshold to distinct reporters within the required window using ticket times. A single ticket mentioning multiple teams does not establish multiple tickets from distinct reporters.
5. Identify all tickets belonging to each qualifying incident. Leave unrelated requests, excluded issues, and groups below the threshold unchanged.
6. Apply only the required updates. For the demonstrated SOP, add incident-core, set priority=high and category=incident, and leave tickets open. Preserve unrelated fields and existing tags.
7. Inspect returned ticket states for the required fields and open status. If a response lacks sufficient state, read the affected ticket before claiming success.
8. Output one line per confirmed updated ticket in the requested format, with a reason identifying the shared cluster failure and threshold basis.
## 验证
- Every incident group meets the supplied distinct-reporter threshold within its reporting window.
- Direct failures and confirmed cascading symptoms are grouped by root cause; different clusters and mere mentions of multiple teams are not combined.
- Each updated ticket has the required tag, priority, and category and remains open; unrelated and excluded tickets receive no mutations.
- The final output includes only confirmed updates and follows the requested line format.
